dialogues.jp:
（午後の授業ってやつは、どうして、こう眠く
　なるのかな……）
dialogues.en:
"(Why do I always feel like sleeping during the afternoon
classes...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Why do I always feel like sleeping during the afternoon
classes...)"

dialogues.jp:
今は現国の授業中。講師が物語中の登場人物の
心情について述べている。
dialogues.en:
It was Literature class. The teacher was trying to elaborate
on the mentality and feelings of the characters in some
legend.
dialogues.text:
It was Literature class. The teacher was trying to elaborate
on the mentality and feelings of the characters in some
legend.

dialogues.jp:
本の中にいるヤツの心が分かったって、仕方な
いだろうに。
dialogues.en:
Of course, knowing the feelings of some book's character
isn't going to be of much use in the future.
dialogues.text:
Of course, knowing the feelings of some book's character
isn't going to be of much use in the future.

dialogues.jp:
ようは、それを読んだ人間が感じた思いこそが、
現国の求める読解力の授業だと思う……。
dialogues.en:
This class would be more centered on trying to increase our
capability of reading and understanding literature...
dialogues.text:
This class would be more centered on trying to increase our
capability of reading and understanding literature...

dialogues.jp: 睡眠学習で励むとしよう。
現国の授業を睡眠学習で乗り切ることにした。
dialogues.en: I "sleepstudy" my way through the literature class.
dialogues.text: I "sleepstudy" my way through the literature class.
